technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with short-term bullish technicals (Hull flip, RSI rising, OBV rising) offset by weak intermediate trend structure (below 50-day MAs, below Ichimoku cloud) and overbought conditions limiting upside probability.

fundamental.summary: AES shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 59 days.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (699+ days old) and provides no conviction signal; neutral to slightly bearish setup absent recent news confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (455.84), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and macro_score of -4 create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 59 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip up, rising RSI(9), and rising OBV provide short-term momentum confirmation with price near support (18.1426), offering a contrarian entry in fear-driven market conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Crisis VIX, price below both 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud, overbought stochastics/Williams %R, weak fundamentals (no insider/institutional conviction), high earnings risk in 59 days, and unfavourable macro environment (-4 score) create excessive headwinds that outweigh short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Hull flip and rising RSI(9) provide short-term momentum confirmation at support, but this is insufficient to overcome crisis macro conditions and weak fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis VIX (455.84), unfavourable macro environment, and high earnings risk in 59 days create excessive downside exposure that negates short-term technical strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 63 positions in Utilities sector; adding AES increases concentration risk in low-volatility sector during macro stress without offsetting conviction.
